name: Futaba Minazuki
source:
Like her older twin sister [Url=/c98545]Mizuki[/url], Minazuki is a secretary for the Student Council. Minazuki thinks that Mizuki lacks common sense and has too much confidence, but she loves and relies on her anyway.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
